title: Verify incomplete coverage metadata in OpenAQ sensor responses
problem: API #404 reports a location sensor-list HTTP 500 when reporting-period metadata is missing. The pinned original SQL functions produce the five reported null fields, which fail the original API response model. This synthetic contract reproduction does not establish deployed frequency or the intended database/API fix.
humanitarian_relevance: OpenAQ supports community access to pollution measurements. Preventing a sensor metadata failure from interrupting data access could aid analysis; no affected humanitarian user, health outcome or realized benefit is established.

evidence.claim: The issue reports a location sensor-list error; a diagnostic comment attributes five response-validation errors to missing logging/averaging values and proposes requiring those values in the database.

At the pinned source revision, Sensor.coverage permits null but Coverage requires non-null numeric/string fields. The original sensor route calls calculate_coverage with reporting periods when a latest value exists. This is static source evidence, not a reproduced server error.

Eight original-model/synthetic FastAPI scenarios passed expected assertions, including HTTP 500 for incomplete coverage and mixed valid/invalid sensors. Seven outputs from two unchanged SQL coverage functions were checked against the original model; two zero-period controls returned SQLSTATE 22012. The original router and deployed schema were not exercised.

All 24 original sensor-route scenarios met assertions using the original query builder, response models and unedited DB.fetchPage with synthetic DB.fetch rows. Both endpoints reject incomplete coverage; valid and absent coverage pass. Database init.sql includes tables/metadata.sql, where both period columns are nullable integers without defaults in their definitions. Deployed constraints and ingestion remain unverified.

Read-only ingestion review locates a realtime new-sensor insert that omits both dedicated period columns and an LCS upsert that writes staged intervals. Organization policy requires LLM disclosure and says wholly LLM-written work is unlikely to be accepted except possible case-by-case review. This constrains contribution readiness; ingestion execution and acceptance are not established.

code_surface: API 87c060c28f5b484e0e9953d247082f5e678935c9: Coverage/Sensor/SensorsResponse, original sensor routes, QueryBuilder and DB.fetchPage. Database 0e49c258186372f4af6c5679a4e1ab47157f0158: calculate_coverage in idempotent/util_functions.sql; init.sql includes tables/metadata.sql, which adds both period columns as nullable integers.
proposed_change: Prepared inquiry asks whether the disclosed bot contribution mode is welcome and whether to scope API handling, ingestion/database invariants or both. Wait for maintainer direction before implementing; do not invent periods or change nullability without agreement.
priority_rationale: Air-pollution burden and named OpenAQ community use motivate this research path. Select the unassigned sensor-access report over future SDK cleanup and already-owned Explorer/API fixes. No implementation priority or realized impact is implied.
tests: Prior eight model/HTTP scenarios and nine SQL checks passed. Now 24 original-router scenarios pass: ten row conditions on each endpoint plus four invalid-ID controls. Original QueryBuilder and unedited DB.fetchPage execute with synthetic DB.fetch rows; expected validation exceptions and HTTP effects checked separately. All 22 fetched API and 21 database files remain unchanged. Full SQL joins, middleware, upstream suite and deployed data remain untested.
environment: Isolated Python 3.13.7 environment installed 17 lockfile-hashed wheels without source builds. Original response models use Pydantic 2.11.1 and FastAPI 0.115.12. SQL ran in a fresh temporary PostgreSQL 14.18 cluster in single-user mode. Both probes ran with OS network denial; no listening service, existing database, cloud deployment or operational data request. Full application/test setup remains unresolved. The original router and query builder now run with original response wrapping and synthetic DB.fetch rows; no additional packages or connection settings needed.
maintainer: Issue #404 remains open, unassigned and unlocked with one diagnostic comment and no linked PR in the refreshed timeline. A disclosed inquiry is prepared for human review and has not been posted. No confirmed scope, reviewer commitment or reply date.
risks: OpenAQ says wholly LLM-written contributions are unlikely to be accepted, subject to case-by-case review. Ingestion paths differ, so required database periods need an ingestion/backfill decision. Deployed constraints, actual prevalence, affected users, full regression environment and independent human review remain unresolved.

humanitarian_relevance_supported.rationale: Project-reported community measurement use in Ghana and Malawi establishes a plausible environmental-health data pathway; contribution-specific health benefit is not claimed.

repository_active.rationale: Repository is unarchived with a May 2026 push and a June 2026 sensor issue with diagnostic discussion. Live inventory contains ten issues and six PRs; this does not establish review availability.

external_contributions_accepted.rationale: The pinned contribution guide explicitly welcomes fork-based pull requests. General invitation does not establish bot eligibility or acceptance of this scope.

contribution_policy_understood.rationale: Read the pinned API contribution guide, MIT license and organization contribution/conduct rules. They require compliance with the linked organization LLM policy; no agreement or additional permission was inferred.

ai_policy_understood.rationale: Explicit organization LLM policy requires disclosure and contributor understanding, and says wholly LLM-written contributions are unlikely to be accepted with possible case-by-case review. The policy is understood; Humanifest eligibility and scope acceptance are not established.

problem_current_and_consequential.rationale: The open report and synthetic original-route reproduction establish a plausible failure mechanism. Its deployed prevalence, affected users and practical consequence remain unverified.

behavior_reproducible_or_verifiable.rationale: Original SQL produces the reported null fields. Original sensor routes, QueryBuilder and unedited DB.fetchPage reproduce the expected response-validation errors and HTTP 500 with synthetic database rows; valid/absent coverage, empty results and invalid IDs provide controls. Full middleware, SQL joins and deployment remain outside this probe.

code_and_tests_located.rationale: Located original Coverage/Sensor/SensorsResponse models, location-sensor route and existing sensor smoke tests. Existing tests do not directly demonstrate incomplete-coverage handling.

change_bounded.rationale: Current ingestor realtime insert omits dedicated periods, while LCS writes staged intervals. Required database values may need ingestion/backfill changes; desired API versus ingestion scope remains unconfirmed.

regression_strategy_credible.rationale: Executed controls distinguish valid, absent, null, incomplete, mixed and zero-observation responses, and default versus explicit-null SQL periods. They provide a reproducible contract regression basis; original-route integration and any eventual database constraint still require tests matching the agreed fix.

no_private_data_required.rationale: The reported failure concerns null fields in a public response contract. Synthetic sensor metadata can test that contract without retrieving real sensor records or operational credentials.

security_and_licensing_risk_acceptable.rationale: Bounded synthetic probes used lockfile-hashed wheels and OS network denial after setup inspection. Full dependency/license/contribution audit for an implementation remains incomplete; no production data or access requested.

environment_feasible.rationale: Original models, routes, query builder, response wrapping and PostgreSQL calculation probes run in an isolated environment. Full application setup, deployed schema and upstream suite remain unresolved; current checked-in period definitions have been located.

maintainer_interest_confirmed.rationale: Prepared inquiry remains unsent pending human review. Existing diagnosis, generic contribution invitation and case-by-case LLM policy do not establish acceptance of Humanifest work.

probable_reviewer_identified.rationale: Issue author and diagnostic commenter are visible, but no reviewer has agreed to review Humanifest work.

benefit_justifies_review_cost.rationale: Data-access benefit is plausible, but frequency, affected users and comparative cost of a database versus API change remain unmeasured.

user_can_explain_line_by_line.rationale: No production patch or independent human code review exists.

score_basis: Named environmental-health data use supports investigation. Synthetic original-SQL/model execution verifies the reported contract mechanism; route integration, maintainer acceptance and deployment remain unverified, so implementation score stays zero.
